errors.sharedCaseMark: The {{key}} row marks the case of {{name}}, which shares a part of its URL with another value
errors.ampersandEntityName: The {{key}} row sets {{name}}, which the ampersand mark reads as another parameter
errors.statefulCheckRegex: The check of {{name}} is a pattern with a g or y flag, which answers differently on a second call
errors.unanchoredCheckRegex: The check of {{name}} is a pattern without ^ at its start and $ at its end
errors.misplacedOpenTail: The {{key}} row writes {/tail*} elsewhere than at the end of its path
errors.openTailBesideMultiSegment: The {{key}} row writes {/tail*} in a path with {{name}}, which takes several segments, so the two are split by a guess
errors.openTailName: The {{key}} row names a value tail, which {/tail*} is read as
errors.unsupportedTemplateExpression: The template {{template}} writes {{expression}}, an operator or modifier no template takes
errors.oldTemplateSpelling: The template {{template}} writes {{expression}}, which is spelled {{spelling}}
errors.misplacedReserved: The template {{template}} writes {{expression}} outside its path, or beside a list or an open tail
errors.uncheckedListSplit: The {{key}} row writes {{list}} in front of {{reserved}} with a check on neither, so the two are split by a guess
errors.semicolonInQuery: The {{key}} row writes ; in its query, which the semicolon mark reads as a separator
errors.mixedListName: The {{key}} row writes {{name}} as one value, which another template writes as a list
errors.unbalancedBrace: The template {{template}} writes a brace outside a complete expression
